evidence_quotes:
If vehicle has been operating, use
extreme care to avoid being burned
when removing cooling system
radiator cap.
statements.reason: The warning gives this precaution if the vehicle has been operating.
statements.statement: After vehicle operation, the cooling-system PMCS warning calls for extreme care to avoid burns when removing the radiator cap.

evidence_quotes:
If vehicle has been operating, use
extreme care to avoid being burned
when removing cooling system
radiator cap. Use heavy rags or gloves
to protect hands.
statements.reason: The same warning specifies hand protection.
statements.statement: After vehicle operation, the cooling-system PMCS warning calls for heavy rags or gloves to protect hands when removing the radiator cap.

evidence_quotes:
If vehicle has been operating, use
extreme care to avoid being burned
when removing cooling system
radiator cap. Use heavy rags or gloves
to protect hands. Turn radiator cap
only one-half turn counterclockwise
and allow pressure to be released
before fully removing cap.
statements.reason: The same warning specifies the half-turn and pressure-release steps before removal.
statements.statement: After vehicle operation, the cooling-system PMCS warning calls for turning the radiator cap only one-half turn counterclockwise and allowing pressure to release before fully removing it.
